definitions.gloss: and so, because of that, therefore
definitions.explanation: A conjunction indicating that something happens as a result of what was previously mentioned.
Used to prompt someone to continue their story or explanation.

examples.japanese: それで⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れました→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。それで⟦{遅|おく}れました→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The train was delayed. Because of that, I was late.
It was raining. So I stayed home.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。それで⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{買|か}えなかった→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I had no money. So I couldn't buy anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。それで⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Work was busy. So I had no time to meet friends.

examples.japanese: それで、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
それで、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: So, how did it go? Were you able to do it well?

examples.japanese: それで、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦{会|あ}えます→会う：00482_au⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: So, what will you do tomorrow? Can we meet?

notes:
それで is a conjunction indicating consequence or result, meaning "and so" or "because of that."

TWO USES:
1. Indicating result/consequence: "So I went home" (それで⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧)
2. Prompting continuation: "And then?" (それで？)

COMPARISON WITH ⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧:
- それで: neutral, narrative, simply links cause and effect
- だから: emphasizes the causal relationship, more assertive

COMMON PATTERNS:
- それで？: And? So? (prompting)
- それで、どうなった？: So, what happened?

RELATED CONJUNCTIONS:
- ⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧: therefore, so (emphasizes reason)
- ⟦そして→そして：00997_soshite⟧: and then (sequential)
- ⟦それから→それから：00996_sorekara⟧: after that (sequential)
